question: Extract high-quality total RNA from pecan (Carya illinoinensis) embryos for small RNA and transcriptome sequencing. Pecan embryos are oil-rich and polyphenol-rich, and the tissue is recalcitrant to standard extraction.
source_text: Extract high-quality total RNA from pecan (Carya illinoinensis) embryos for small RNA and transcriptome sequencing. Pecan embryos are oil-rich and polyphenol-rich, and the tissue is recalcitrant to standard extraction.
